title: Mortgage insurance is not a penalty
music: synthesized score where every floor letter and prop rings a vibraphone or pizzicato note in key; silences at 12.4s and 40.6s
topic: Canadian mortgage default insurance: under 20% down, protects the lender, enables 5% down, premium tiers, example $500K at 5% down, sales tax paid in cash
hook: Mortgage insurance is not a penalty.
logline: A first-time buyer with only 5% saved walks one street to her front door and discovers that the insurance she thought was a penalty is the thing that lifts the barrier.
structure: One street to the door. Setup 0-12s (under 20% down needs default insurance; the shield rises behind the bank, not her), turn 12.4-18.9s (silence, barrier sign flips 20% to 5%, barrier lifts on the downbeat), honest costs 19-40s (premium bars 4.00 / 3.10 / 2.80%, $19,000 crate on a $475,000 loan = $494,000, sales tax paid in cash at the closing counter), payoff 40.6-53.2s (door opens, roof lifts off, camera runs back to the start where the next buyer stands = loop).
device: one continuous isometric street with each key number painted on the floor as the narrator says it; a barrier that flips from 20% to 5% and lifts; roof lifting off the house; faceless buyers as the diagram
